intent: Bounded source-component surface hierarchy for foundation, structural frame, enclosure, roof and service access; scalar PBR only. This successor keeps current-world lighting/composition and every non-infill Building surface fixed while lifting only the enclosure infill albedo so authored solid rear infill reads as solid material rather than near-black/open void in the current Map proof. The exact source-owned header-segmentation successor is material-bound explicitly by emitted segment ID rather than wildcard inheritance. No UV, texture, weathering, engineering coating, runtime or final art acceptance is implied.
